class.name: NetwDatabase

method.name: batch
method.description: Returns a [NetwWriteBatch] that submits several writes and erasures to this database in one call. It is synchronous, and nothing reaches storage until the batch is submitted.

method.name: close
method.description: Stops admitting work, waits for everything already admitted to settle and settles with a [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. An operation issued before the close settles normally. One that was still going on when the connection closed settles as canceled and never as a save. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the database is closed ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived the session that issued it [/codeblock]

method.name: delete_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot] and everything stored in it, then settles with a [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. Deleting the slot this process holds open is refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY]. Useful to delete a save the game has not loaded. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend removed the slot ┠╴ERR_BUSY slot is the one this database holds open ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database declares no backend ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived its session, or the backend │ implements no _delete_slot ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the backend's _delete_slot answered no promise ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not remove the slot [/codeblock]

method.name: erase
method.description: Removes the record at [param id] and settles with a [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend acknowledged the erase ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 unsettled operations ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER │ id is empty ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the connection answered no outcome for the erase ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend or connection cannot perform the erase, or the │ database closed before it settled ┖╴backend-defined the backend rejected or could not complete the erase [/codeblock]

method.name: flush
method.description: Settles with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error] once every operation admitted before this call has settled. A value changed after the call is not included. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK every earlier operation settled, whatever each one settled with ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the session ended first, or this handle outlived it [/codeblock]

method.name: list_slots
method.description: All the slots the [NetwDatabaseBackend] holds, whether or not this process wrote them, settles with a [Dictionary]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error @GlobalScope.Error. Check it before reading slots │ ┠╴OK listing succeeded │ ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend does not implement slot listing │ ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read its storage ┠╴detail String empty when error is OK, otherwise a human-readable │ explanation from the backend ┖╴slots PackedStringArray every slot the backend holds when error is OK [/codeblock] A backend-specific error is defined by the [method NetwDatabaseBackend._list_slots] implementation, see the concrete backend's documentation for its error mapping.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens [param slot] and settles with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. Opening a different slot is refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY], so [method close] the one that is open first. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK slot is open, or was open already ┠╴ERR_BUSY another slot is open or opening, or the database is closing ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database declares no backend ┠╴ERR_CANT_CREATE the backend resolved no connection ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the backend's _open answered no promise ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived its session, or the backend implements │ no _open ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not open slot [/codeblock]

method.name: patch
method.description: Replaces the fields [param values] names in the record at [param id], keeps the rest, and settles with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. A record that is not there is refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. An empty [param values] succeeds without touching storage. A field the schema does not declare refuses the whole patch. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴column_name replacement value ┖╴... ... ... [/codeblock] The dictionary may contain any subset of the columns in [param schema], including none. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend acknowledged the merged record, or values is empty ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open, or the schema declares no │ migration from the stored record's storage version ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 unsettled operations ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed, or no record is stored at id ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER │ id is empty ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA values names an undeclared column or a value its column │ refuses, or the stored record does not match the schema ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED │ the stored record is not in this library's format, or │ carries a newer storage version than the schema ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend or connection cannot perform the patch, or the │ database closed before it settled ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read or write the record [/codeblock]

method.name: read
method.description: Reads the record at [param id] and settles with a [Dictionary] snapshot. Absence and failure are separate answers. A record not saved yet settles with [code]found=false[/code] and [code]error[/code] [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. A record that cannot be read due to a problem with the database, schema, or id fails the promise. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error @GlobalScope.Error. Check it before reading anything else ┠╴detail String what went wrong, for a person to read. Empty when error is OK ┠╴found bool whether a record was stored under id. False on any failure ┠╴id StringName the record id the read asked for ┖╴values Dictionary the stored row, keyed by column name, complete against the schema that read it. Empty unless found is true [/codeblock] [codeblock] var read: Dictionary = await db.read(PlayerSave.schema, account_id).wait() if read.error != OK: show_load_error(read.error) return if read.found: player.gold = read.values[&"gold"] [/codeblock]

method.name: scan
method.description: Reads storage a page at a time, settling with a [Dictionary] of up to [param limit] records matching [param filter]. A page fails whole a single record the schema cannot read leaves [code]records[/code] empty and [code]error[/code] set. The scan is finished when [code]cursor[/code] is empty. Pass the page's cursor back as [param cursor] to continue. A [param cursor] is an opaque string that the [NetwDatabaseBackend] returns to continue a scan. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error @GlobalScope.Error. Check it before reading records │ ┠╴OK the page was read │ ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED a record is not in this library's format, or carries │ │ a newer storage version than the schema │ ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA a record does not match the schema │ ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the schema declares no migration from a record's │ │ storage version │ ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE this handle outlived its session, or the connection │ │ implements no _scan │ ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read the page ┠╴detail String what went wrong, for a person to read. Empty when error is OK ┠╴records Array[Dictionary] each one a read reply, drawn on read ┖╴cursor String pass this back to scan to continue. Empty when no records remain [/codeblock] These fail the promise, and [method NetwPromise.wait] answers the code. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_BUSY the database already holds 4096 unsettled operations ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER limit is below 1 ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the database closed before the page settled [/codeblock] [codeblock] var cursor := "" while true: var page: Dictionary = await db.scan(PlayerSave.schema, {}, cursor).wait() if page.error != OK: show_load_error(page.error) return for read in page.records: roster.append(read.values) if page.cursor.is_empty(): break cursor = page.cursor [/codeblock]

method.name: write
method.description: Replaces the whole record at [param id] and settles with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error]. [param values] must carry every column [param schema] declares, at the declared type and stride, and nothing else. A row that does not is refused before the backend sees it, so a bad write never reaches storage. A successful write means the backing store acknowledged it. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the backend acknowledged the write ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the database is not open ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the schema is not sealed ┠╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER │ id is empty ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA values do not exactly match the schema ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the backend or connection cannot perform the write ┖╴backend-defined the backend rejected or could not complete the write [/codeblock] [codeblock] var error: Error = await db.write(PlayerSave.schema, account_id, { &"gold": player.gold, &"position": player.position, }).wait() [/codeblock]

signal.name: failed
signal.description:
Emitted when an entity row in this database fails to load or save. [param detail] names the record. [param error] is one of the codes [method NetwPersistenceHandle.load] and [method NetwPersistenceHandle.save] list. [param detail] follows the record id with the storage's own explanation, and counts the rows when one save left several unsaved. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.database(self, &"saves").failed.connect(show_save_error)
func show_save_error(_error: Error, detail: String) -> void: status.text = detail [/codeblock]
